description: Photograph taken from inside a military transport helicopter looking out the open rear cargo ramp. A soldier in multicam camouflage, helmet and body armor stands at the ramp edge holding an unfurled American flag that streams in the airflow, with arid, rugged mountain terrain far below. description: Meme comparing the scale of two political scandals using a photo of a large white cruise ship beside a tiny boat at sea. A black arrow labels the cruise ship 'OBAMAGATE' while a red arrow and circle label the small boat 'WATERGATE', implying the claimed Obamagate scandal dwarfs Watergate. The ship's funnel logo is consistent with a Princess Cruises vessel, though the ship itself is incidental to the joke.
